import_batches_filename_safe.name: import_batches_filename_safe
import_batches_filename_safe.value:
"import_batches"."filename" <> ''
        and strpos("import_batches"."filename", '/') = 0
        and strpos("import_batches"."filename", chr(92)) = 0
        and "import_batches"."filename" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

import_batches_counts_nonnegative.name: import_batches_counts_nonnegative
import_batches_counts_nonnegative.value:
"import_batches"."row_count" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."error_count" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."warning_count" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."duplicate_review_count" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."committed_count" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."skipped_count" >= 0
        and "import_batches"."reverted_count" >= 0

merge_events_incomplete_pair_unique.name: merge_events_incomplete_pair_unique
merge_events_incomplete_pair_unique.where:
"merge_events"."completed_at" is null
          and "merge_events"."reversed_at" is null
          and "merge_events"."status" in ('planned', 'manual_remediation_required')

ccp_current_contact_channel_unique.name: ccp_current_contact_channel_unique
ccp_current_contact_channel_unique.where: "contact_channel_permissions"."revoked_at" is null and "contact_channel_permissions"."superseded_by_id" is null and "contact_channel_permissions"."expires_at" is null

ocr_current_org_unique.name: ocr_current_org_unique
ocr_current_org_unique.where: "organization_communication_restrictions"."channel" is null and "organization_communication_restrictions"."revoked_at" is null and "organization_communication_restrictions"."superseded_by_id" is null and "organization_communication_restrictions"."expires_at" is null

ocr_current_org_channel_unique.name: ocr_current_org_channel_unique
ocr_current_org_channel_unique.where: "organization_communication_restrictions"."channel" is not null and "organization_communication_restrictions"."revoked_at" is null and "organization_communication_restrictions"."superseded_by_id" is null and "organization_communication_restrictions"."expires_at" is null

suppress_current_contact_channel_unique.name: suppress_current_contact_channel_unique
suppress_current_contact_channel_unique.where: "suppression_entries"."scope" = 'contact_channel' and "suppression_entries"."revoked_at" is null and "suppression_entries"."superseded_by_id" is null and "suppression_entries"."expires_at" is null

suppress_current_org_unique.name: suppress_current_org_unique
suppress_current_org_unique.where: "suppression_entries"."scope" = 'organization' and "suppression_entries"."revoked_at" is null and "suppression_entries"."superseded_by_id" is null and "suppression_entries"."expires_at" is null

suppress_current_org_channel_unique.name: suppress_current_org_channel_unique
suppress_current_org_channel_unique.where: "suppression_entries"."scope" = 'organization_channel' and "suppression_entries"."revoked_at" is null and "suppression_entries"."superseded_by_id" is null and "suppression_entries"."expires_at" is null

suppress_current_global_identifier_uniqu.name: suppress_current_global_identifier_unique
suppress_current_global_identifier_uniqu.where: "suppression_entries"."scope" = 'global' and "suppression_entries"."identifier_hash" is not null and "suppression_entries"."revoked_at" is null and "suppression_entries"."superseded_by_id" is null and "suppression_entries"."expires_at" is null

suppress_current_global_channel_identifi.name: suppress_current_global_channel_identifier_unique
suppress_current_global_channel_identifi.where: "suppression_entries"."scope" = 'global_channel' and "suppression_entries"."identifier_hash" is not null and "suppression_entries"."revoked_at" is null and "suppression_entries"."superseded_by_id" is null and "suppression_entries"."expires_at" is null

suppress_contact_channel_scope_valid.name: suppress_contact_channel_scope_valid
suppress_contact_channel_scope_valid.value: "suppression_entries"."scope" <> 'contact_channel' or ("suppression_entries"."contact_id" is not null and "suppression_entries"."channel" is not null)

suppress_organization_scope_valid.name: suppress_organization_scope_valid
suppress_organization_scope_valid.value: "suppression_entries"."scope" <> 'organization' or ("suppression_entries"."organization_id" is not null and "suppression_entries"."channel" is null)

suppress_organization_channel_scope_vali.name: suppress_organization_channel_scope_valid
suppress_organization_channel_scope_vali.value: "suppression_entries"."scope" <> 'organization_channel' or ("suppression_entries"."organization_id" is not null and "suppression_entries"."channel" is not null)

suppress_identifier_pair_valid.name: suppress_identifier_pair_valid
suppress_identifier_pair_valid.value: ("suppression_entries"."identifier_type" is null and "suppression_entries"."identifier_hash" is null) or ("suppression_entries"."identifier_type" is not null and "suppression_entries"."identifier_hash" is not null)

evidence_records_subject_org_or_contact.name: evidence_records_subject_org_or_contact
evidence_records_subject_org_or_contact.value:
("evidence_records"."subject_type" = 'organization' and "evidence_records"."organization_id" is not null and "evidence_records"."contact_id" is null)
        or ("evidence_records"."subject_type" = 'contact' and "evidence_records"."contact_id" is not null and "evidence_records"."organization_id" is null)

evidence_records_effective_window_valid.name: evidence_records_effective_window_valid
evidence_records_effective_window_valid.value: "evidence_records"."expires_at" is null or "evidence_records"."effective_at" is null or "evidence_records"."expires_at" > "evidence_records"."effective_at"

research_observations_subject_org_or_con.name: research_observations_subject_org_or_contact
research_observations_subject_org_or_con.value:
("research_observations"."subject_type" = 'organization' and "research_observations"."organization_id" is not null and "research_observations"."contact_id" is null)
        or ("research_observations"."subject_type" = 'contact' and "research_observations"."contact_id" is not null and "research_observations"."organization_id" is null)

variable_values_subject_org_or_contact.name: variable_values_subject_org_or_contact
variable_values_subject_org_or_contact.value:
("variable_values"."subject_type" = 'organization' and "variable_values"."organization_id" is not null and "variable_values"."contact_id" is null)
        or ("variable_values"."subject_type" = 'contact' and "variable_values"."contact_id" is not null and "variable_values"."organization_id" is null)

variable_values_effective_window_valid.name: variable_values_effective_window_valid
variable_values_effective_window_valid.value: "variable_values"."expires_at" is null or "variable_values"."effective_at" is null or "variable_values"."expires_at" > "variable_values"."effective_at"

variable_values_override_metadata_valid.name: variable_values_override_metadata_valid
variable_values_override_metadata_valid.value: "variable_values"."manual_override_flag" = false or ("variable_values"."override_actor" is not null and "variable_values"."override_at" is not null)
